blocks.name: Annotated pose ray evidence - not a detection
T-LESS object 8 capture 261 - ANNOTATION ONLY
blocks.description: This stored evidence graph runs no locator. Colored points are expected CAD geometry, not extra sensor returns; gray points are measured depth. Green: ray agreement, not pose acceptance. Red: farther return/free space. Orange: nearer return. Magenta: missing exact depth. Blue-gray: grazing ray. RGB axes: supplied annotated pose. Orbit the native RGB cloud; full native maps, camera, counts, physical tolerance and source hashes are exported alongside it. T-LESS, Hodan et al., WACV 2017, CC BY 4.0; see ../ATTRIBUTION.md and https://cmp.felk.cvut.cz/t-less/. No annotated pose counts as a detection.
